# Voxen Insights

Voxen Insights publishes practical Korean-language articles about applying data engineering, AI automation, trend analysis, APIs, dashboards, and business systems to real business growth.

## Core business topics
- Data collection and data engineering
- AI automation and AI agents
- Google, Naver, TikTok and commerce trend analysis
- Business dashboards and APIs
- Sales, marketing and operational automation
- Custom software systems for business workflows

## Articles
- [경쟁사 가격·상품 데이터를 자동 수집해서 매출 기회 찾는 방법](https://soonyeol-huh.github.io/auto_blog/posts/competitor-price-data-automation/): How to collect competitor price, stock, review and product data, normalize it, detect changes and connect alerts, dashboards and AI analysis.
- [내 비즈니스에 AI를 적용하고 매출 10배 올리기](https://soonyeol-huh.github.io/auto_blog/posts/ai-business-10x-revenue/): A practical guide to connecting AI with customer acquisition, market research, marketing, sales, operations, and feedback loops.
